title: Melissa Meredith (CEO of a public benefit corporation) sets the book against the NYT business-school argument — 'value creation vs. value captured'
summary: Responding to Christopher Marquis's New York Times piece and its finding that business-educated CEOs raised shareholder value while wages fell and output did not move, the co-founder of a public benefit corporation puts the two arguments side by side: Marquis calling for the end of business schools and Eric calling for the end of shareholder primacy, for the same underlying reason. She points to the PBC structure as a tool already available and names the book as where to start.
blockquote: Eric Ries called for the end of the shareholder primacy era for nearly the same reason that Christopher called for the end of business schools - value creation vs. value captured.
attribution_title: CEO & Co-Founder, Collective Kairos (a public benefit corporation)
